E01.title: Zapata Dominguez et al. (2023) · Si–graphite manufacturing
E01.finding: Calendering and coating conditions affected architecture and ionic resistance.
E01.caveat: Supports a mechanism; no universal pore-fraction failure threshold.

E02.title: Burdette-Trofimov et al. (2020) · Electrode spatial heterogeneity
E02.finding: Processing changed architecture in silicon/PAA electrodes.
E02.caveat: Void variation does not identify binder or silicon segregation.

E03.title: Müller et al. (2018) · Nanoscale mechanical degradation
E03.finding: Particle–carbon/binder gaps appeared after initial cycling in SiOx/graphite.
E03.caveat: Special contrast resolved interfaces that v1 does not resolve.

E04.title: Lu et al. (2025) · Graphite/silicon electro-chemo-mechanics
E04.finding: Lithiation changed pore space, contacts, contrast and strain.
E04.caveat: Bright area is not weight fraction; no swelling limit follows.

E05.title: Liu et al. (2012) · Size-dependent silicon fracture
E05.finding: True crystalline Si particle size affected first-lithiation fracture.
E05.caveat: Bright specks are not verified whole particles; no transferable size cutoff.

E06.title: Kim et al. (2025) · Si/graphite wetting diagnosis
E06.finding: Incomplete wetting affected ionic resistance and formation behavior in full cells.
E06.caveat: A dry image does not measure liquid saturation or metallic lithium.

E07.title: Davoodabadi et al. (2019) · Calendering and wetting
E07.finding: Calendering trades increased density against slower wetting.
E07.caveat: General LIB evidence; not a wetting equation for these measurements.

E08.title: Müller et al. (2022) · Carbon-coated Si@graphite
E08.finding: Composite stability and conductivity depended on coating and calendering.
E08.caveat: No validated size/count rule identifies composite disintegration.

E10.title: Keller et al. (2021) · Nano-silicon size and shape
E10.finding: Specific surface area related to first-cycle irreversible capacity in Si half cells.
E10.caveat: Bright-object size and dark adjacency do not measure reactive surface.

E11.title: Burdette-Trofimov et al. (2021) · Silicon slurry clustering
E11.finding: Binder preparation and shear changed slurry clustering.
E11.caveat: Scattering clusters are not dried-section centroid spacing.

OE01.title: Kim et al. (2026) · Fast charging of Si–graphite
OE01.finding: Architecture affected fast charging; Si could delay plating onset.
OE01.caveat: No transferable C-rate, plating probability or lifetime threshold.

OE02.title: Yoshida et al. (2017) · High-rate graphite/SiOx
OE02.finding: Current concentration in SiOx was linked to high-rate degradation.
OE02.caveat: Recipe-specific half-cell observations do not establish a universal rate limit.

OE03.title: Kirkaldy et al. (2022) · Loss of active silicon
OE03.finding: Low full-cell SOC cycling strongly utilized silicon in the studied commercial cells.
OE03.caveat: Full-cell SOC is not silicon SOC; loss of Si capacity is not whole-cell loss.

OE04.title: Wan et al. (2025) · Pressure, temperature and SOC
OE04.finding: Pressure and thermal/SOC choices produced competing benefits in the tested cells.
OE04.caveat: Test conditions are not suggested safe or optimum operating limits.

OE05.title: Ha et al. (2021) · Temperature and electrolyte chemistry
OE05.finding: Temperature and electrolyte changed chemical loss mechanisms.
OE05.caveat: Half-cell counter-electrode effects limit transfer to full cells.

OE06.title: Rodrigues et al. (2023) · Four-year calendar aging
OE06.finding: Calendar exposure, prior cycling and electrode contributions affected aging.
OE06.caveat: Different group histories prevent a clean one-variable storage comparison.

OE07.title: McBrayer et al. (2023) · Silicon calendar aging
OE07.finding: Time-driven chemical contributions dominated in an Si-rich system.
OE07.caveat: Adjacent 80 wt% Si evidence cannot calibrate lifetime for this electrode.

OE08.title: Müller et al. (2018) · Cycling and interface detachment
OE08.finding: Repeated cycling produced cracking and contact detachment.
OE08.caveat: Study cycle counts are not predicted cycles to failure.

OE09.title: Lu et al. (2025) · Pores, strain and silicon utilization
OE09.finding: Pore loss and contact changes affected rate capability and utilization.
OE09.caveat: The 2D image does not resolve all binder, chemistry or transport effects.

OE10.title: Geslin et al. (2025) · Dynamic discharge cycling
OE10.finding: Some dynamic discharge profiles outlasted constant discharge in the studied cells.
OE10.caveat: Not a pulse-charging recommendation or transferable lifetime improvement.

patterns.title: Constricted pores after densification
patterns.requires: Reviewed mask, matched qualified reference and representative sampling; wetting or resistance measurements for a functional claim.
patterns.action: Compare sections before and after calendering; check thickness, loading, bulk porosity and ionic resistance.
patterns.caveat: Small, scarce dark regions may indicate restricted ion access. Two-dimensional widths do not measure connected pores or tortuosity.

patterns.title: Open packing versus a density target
patterns.requires: Independent mass-loading, thickness and density target measurements.
patterns.action: Check the intended design and measure dry coating mass and thickness across the web.
patterns.caveat: Open packing may be intentional expansion space, not a defect.

patterns.title: Uneven void distribution
patterns.requires: Reviewed mask, matched reference, repeated sampling across width and depth.
patterns.action: Inspect high- and low-void regions; compare mixing, coating and compression records.
patterns.caveat: The average can hide local variation. Void variation does not prove chemical segregation or drying as the cause.

patterns.title: Crowded silicon-rich objects with a coarse tail
patterns.requires: Verified silicon phase and actual particle outlines, matched particle reference.
patterns.action: Compare incoming powder, slurry and dried electrode; validate clusters before changing mixing.
patterns.caveat: Centroid clustering does not prove fused agglomerates; current bright specks are not verified whole Si particles.

patterns.title: Coarse true-silicon tail before formation
patterns.requires: Higher-resolution, chemically verified whole-particle sizes and architecture.
patterns.action: Check primary versus secondary particles and test matched specimens during initial lithiation.
patterns.caveat: A nanoparticle fracture threshold cannot be applied to v1 bright-speck sizes.

patterns.title: Composite breakup after calendering
patterns.requires: Matched pre/post-calender specimens and directly verified object breakup.
patterns.action: Compare composite integrity and roll settings; measure electronic resistance if contact loss is suspected.
patterns.caveat: Compression, ROI differences and threshold splitting can mimic smaller, more numerous particles.

patterns.title: Particle fragmentation during formation
patterns.requires: Paired formation stages at matched lithiation state and phase-verified fracture evidence.
patterns.action: Review formation conditions and confirm actual fragments at higher resolution.
patterns.caveat: Lithiation changes contrast; unmatched SOC can mimic loss of bright particles.

patterns.title: New gaps around silicon-rich particles
patterns.requires: Validated Si interfaces, localized gaps and independent conductivity/contact evidence.
patterns.action: Locate the interface and compare manufacturing stages; check conductivity and binder/coating cohesion.
patterns.caveat: Dark adjacency can be intentional expansion space. It does not establish electrical isolation.

patterns.title: Expansion allowance during first charge
patterns.requires: Verified formulation and measured first-charge swelling or paired pore changes.
patterns.action: Measure thickness, strain and pore changes at defined charge states.
patterns.caveat: Silicon area is not silicon weight fraction; binder and graphite also contribute to expansion.

patterns.title: Gap at the current collector
patterns.requires: Additional localized shape analysis and an image containing a verified collector interface; AR_VOID is unavailable in v1.
patterns.action: Acquire a labelled coating/collector section, exclude preparation pullout and measure adhesion.
patterns.caveat: Global H/V ratio does not locate an interface or prove delamination.

patterns.title: Crack-like regions inside the coating
patterns.requires: Localized fissure geometry, preparation checks and additional AR analysis; AR_VOID is unavailable in v1.
patterns.action: Inspect native-resolution and other detector views, then corroborate with repeated preparation or serial sections.
patterns.caveat: Long dark pores and FIB artefacts can resemble cracks.

patterns.title: Wetting deficit with restricted pores
patterns.requires: Fill/soak records and an independent wetting or validated electrochemical diagnostic.
patterns.action: Check fill mass, vacuum, soak time and temperature; compare controlled wetting conditions.
patterns.caveat: Dry images contain no liquid-saturation measurement.

patterns.title: Formation loss and exposed silicon surface
patterns.requires: Surface/chemistry measurements and initial charge/discharge capacity against a declared target.
patterns.action: Measure specific surface and initial efficiency; check full-cell lithium balance and cathode contribution.
patterns.caveat: Bright-speck size and dark adjacency do not measure reactive surface or SEI.

patterns.title: Plating concern during formation
patterns.requires: Independent transport/wetting evidence plus a chemistry-specific plating diagnostic.
patterns.action: Review formation current, temperature and rests, then obtain direct plating evidence.
patterns.caveat: These microscope images cannot identify metallic lithium or assign a plating probability.

patterns.title: Restricted pores under fast charge
patterns.requires: Actual charge/areal current, SOC, cell temperature, loading and independent transport/plating tests.
patterns.action: Qualify the charge profile at controlled SOC and temperature with reference capacity tests.
patterns.caveat: No maximum C-rate or plating probability can be inferred.

patterns.title: Cold charging or regenerative charge
patterns.requires: Measured cell temperature, charging direction, pulse duration, SOC and product-qualified envelope.
patterns.action: Test the actual charge and regenerative profiles with validated plating diagnostics.
patterns.caveat: Ambient temperature is not cell temperature; no image-derived cold-charge limit.

patterns.title: Heterogeneous packing under high charge demand
patterns.requires: Verified silicon objects, spatial evidence, actual charging profile and utilization tests.
patterns.action: Combine representative image sections with controlled high-rate cycling and resistance tests.
patterns.caveat: Void patchiness is not silicon segregation or a current-hotspot detector.

patterns.title: True silicon particles under repeated strain
patterns.requires: Phase-verified whole particles and matched-state cyclic fracture/utilization evidence.
patterns.action: Track particle damage and active silicon capacity in representative cycling tests.
patterns.caveat: Current bright specks cannot establish fracture toughness or cycles to failure.

patterns.title: Verified contact gaps during repeated cycling
patterns.requires: Direct silicon–binder/conductor gap evidence, continuity, pressure and cycling profile.
patterns.action: Compare paired sections and resistance; test plating separately if current redistribution is proposed.
patterns.caveat: High F11 alone cannot activate a contact-loss claim.

patterns.title: Limited expansion space during silicon use
patterns.requires: Composition, loading, measured silicon utilization and SOC-resolved expansion/pressure.
patterns.action: Track swelling and transport across lithiation against declared dimensional targets.
patterns.caveat: No swelling or utilization limit follows from 2D phase fractions.

patterns.title: Open architecture with weak contact support
patterns.requires: Verified electrical contact loss and measured pressure evolution for the actual fixture.
patterns.action: Compare qualified bracing levels using resistance, expansion and capacity tests.
patterns.caveat: Open packing can be beneficial; increasing pressure is not automatically better.

patterns.title: Further compression of a dense electrode
patterns.requires: Actual clamp/pressure–thickness–SOC history and independent transport/contact measurements.
patterns.action: Separate contact improvement from transport restriction in a controlled pressure study.
patterns.caveat: Higher pressure can help contact; v1 cannot calculate a maximum clamp pressure.

patterns.title: Confirmed coating defects under cyclic strain
patterns.requires: Additional localized shape analysis, verified cracks/interface and paired load-test evidence.
patterns.action: Assess defect growth with adhesion/continuity tests under the actual profile.
patterns.caveat: AR_VOID is unavailable; no fatigue law or cycle-to-delamination prediction exists.

patterns.title: Low full-cell SOC with heavy silicon use
patterns.requires: Chemistry-specific silicon utilization model and actual SOC/rate/temperature/throughput history.
patterns.action: Compare candidate windows at matched conditions with a validated component-capacity estimate.
patterns.caveat: A narrow low full-cell SOC window is not necessarily gentle on silicon.

patterns.title: Reactive silicon during warm exposure
patterns.requires: Independent phase/surface/chemistry evidence and actual temperature-time history.
patterns.action: Test full-cell inventory, efficiency and resistance with suitable electrode controls.
patterns.caveat: F03 is not surface area and F11 is not SEI quality; no failure temperature follows.

patterns.title: Long high-SOC storage
patterns.requires: Storage SOC, temperature, dwell, prior history and matched full-cell qualification cohorts.
patterns.action: Track reference capacity, resistance and electrode-specific loss with declared test cadence.
patterns.caveat: Cathode aging may dominate impedance. An anode image cannot forecast shelf life.

patterns.title: Intermittent use with substantial rests
patterns.requires: Verified contact/passivation damage, duty-plus-storage sequence and matched time/throughput controls.
patterns.action: Separate reversible performance, inventory loss and contact changes under the real use sequence.
patterns.caveat: Continuous cycle life cannot be extrapolated directly to calendar life.

patterns.title: High discharge pulses with transport constraints
patterns.requires: Actual discharge waveform, SOC, temperature, cooling, voltage recovery and declared power target.
patterns.action: Measure pulse resistance and recovery; compare actual duty with reference performance tests.
patterns.caveat: Early cutoff may be reversible voltage sag. Discharge pulses do not imply charge-plating risk.
